conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Pinball Table
style.description: An electro-mechanical pinball playfield seen from the player's end, glass off: glossy printed wooden playfield with original abstract art, chrome rails and a steel ball, rubber-ringed posts, mushroom pop bumpers with coloured caps, a drop-target bank, rollover lanes, slingshots, two flippers, a plastic ramp and lit inserts under the playfield, plus a backglass with mechanical score reels. The ball follows a planned contact schedule; every contact lights lamps, drops targets and steps the reels.
motion: Ball: a planned contact schedule, not physics — piecewise ballistic arcs on the tilted field (constant down-table pull), rolls along the orbit rail and the ramp with a quadratic speed profile, and rides on the flipper face for a few frames before each shot.

Every contact is an event: pop bumpers flash their caps and drop their kick ring, slingshot rubbers bulge, drop targets sink one by one, rollover stars dip, and the lettered insert behind each lights.
Inserts are lamps with states: latched on with a flash, blinking 'next shot' arrows, chasing chevrons and an attract ring, completion blinks when a word is finished.
Score reels step one pulse at a time like an EM score motor (queued, ~11 pulses/s) with a small overshoot per step; each pulse sounds a reel click and a chime pitched by its reel.
Camera: the player's end, one slow move per beat, following the ball's area of play; the final shot pulls back to the whole field with the backglass.

objects.procedural: pinball cabinet: wooden side walls and back wall around a tilted playfield, chrome side rails, a lockdown bar, legs and a dark floor

notes.mechanism: pinplan.js: contact schedule -> piecewise ballistic arcs on the tilted field, orbit/ramp rolls with quadratic speed profiles, flipper rides; lamps from rules on the events; reels from queued score-motor pulses.
